subject: Sandbox grant activation + security attestation for LaunchLabs cohort
messages:
From: Anna Morales <anna@launchlabs.io>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sandbox credits for Cohort 42 + security attestation

Hi Priya,

Thanks again for the quick intro last week. LaunchLabs is running Cohort 42 starting June 7; we’d like to request a sandbox grant to support 12 early-stage teams during the 6-week program. High-level ask below: 

- Amount: 2M tokens equivalent (~$4k) per team, pooled (total 24M tokens)
- Window: 2026-06-07 -> 2026-07-19
- Purpose: dev sandboxes for product prototyping, embedding experiments, and an evaluation week at week 5

I’ve attached a short usage plan (LaunchCohort-usage-plan.pdf) and a CSV with the primary account emails. Our procurement team also needs a standard security attestation from vendors (SOC2, encryption at rest, data retention). Can Redwood provide the attestation template or confirm what evidence you can share?

Timeline: would be ideal to have the credits active by June 3 so teams can onboard. Is that feasible?

Thanks — let me know what you need from our side.

Cheers,
Anna Morales
Partnerships Manager | LaunchLabs Accelerator
anna@launchlabs.io

Attachments: LaunchCohort-usage-plan.pdf, cohort-account-list.csv
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Anna Morales <anna@launchlabs.io>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sandbox credits for Cohort 42 + security attestation

Hi Anna — great to hear, and congrats on another cohort.

We can support a pooled sandbox grant for LaunchLabs cohorts; thanks for the usage plan and the CSV. A couple quick items so we can hit your June 3 goal: 

1) Please confirm the list in cohort-account-list.csv maps to Redwood accounts (email addresses that will sign up) and whether teams need isolated projects or a shared sandbox.
2) Confirm preferred billing owner and whether LaunchLabs requires invoiceable sponsorships (or if this is a promo credit managed by Redwood).
3) Security attestation: I’m looping in Hannah from security and Soojin from partner ops to move this forward. Hannah — can you share the attestation template we use for accelerators and list the minimum evidence LaunchLabs should provide?

Operationally Soojin will create a voucher/credit bundle if we proceed. Once we have the account mapping and sign-off on the attestation, we can provision credits and send an activation note + voucher code.

Anna — if you can reply with (1) shared vs isolated sandboxes and (2) confirm the CSV is final, I’ll triage internally and aim for the June 3 activation.

Priya Natarajan
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com
Office: +1 415-555-0192
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Anna Morales <anna@launchlabs.io>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 29 May 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sandbox credits for Cohort 42 + security attestation

Thanks Priya — looping operations in.

Anna: operational checklist from our side and approximate time-to-complete: 
- Confirmed credit bundle: we can encode a single voucher (LL-COHORT42-PROMO) that creates 24M pooled tokens. Alternatively we can create 12 individual vouchers per team if you need isolation. (ETA to create voucher: 1 business day after we have final account mapping)
- Entitlement: credits will be applied at account-level; we can restrict usage to certain API routes (generation vs embeddings) if you want guardrails.
- KMS / data controls: for sandbox use we do not require dedicated keys; if a team needs private deployment we’ll handle via our Private product but that’s out of scope for this promo.
- Activation window: we can schedule activation for 2026-06-03 09:00 PT once paperwork is done.

Please upload the final CSV as a comment to the Drive link (https://drive.google.com/launchlabs/cohort42-plan) or reply with a confirmed list. Also note we’ll need a contact email per account for support entitlements.

Karthik: can you confirm capacity in us-west region for the week of June 14 for the evaluation jobs (likely short bursts, but 150-200k tokens/day across the cohort)?

Thanks — Soojin
Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.com
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>
To: Anna Morales <anna@launchlabs.io>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sandbox credits for Cohort 42 + security attestation

Hi Anna — I handle vendor security attestation for partner promos. Attaching our standard attestation template (security-attestation-template.docx) and the list of minimum evidence. For accelerators we usually accept: 

- SOC 2 Type II report (last 12 months) OR completed vendor security questionnaire (I’ll attach ours if needed)
- Confirmation of encryption at rest and in transit, and key management approach
- Data retention & deletion policy for sandboxed data
- List of subprocessors / third parties that will process Redwood data (if any)
- Latest external penetration test summary (redacted OK)

If LaunchLabs cannot provide SOC 2, a completed questionnaire + pen test summary is acceptable for promotional sandboxes. Please return the filled template to security@redwood.com. Once we have the evidence, Hannah will sign and we can include the attestation as part of the voucher terms.

If timeline is tight, prioritize the CSV and account mapping and we’ll put a conditional activation in place: credits enabled with a timebound hold until the attestation is uploaded (we can revoke if critical items are missing).

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference
hannah@redwood.com

Attachment: security-attestation-template.docx
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Anna Morales <anna@launchlabs.io>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sandbox credits for Cohort 42 + security attestation

Hi Anna — quick update and next steps. Thanks for confirming that the CSV is final and that teams will use shared sandboxes (one project per cohort). Per our ops conversation we’ve provisionally created the voucher: LL-COHORT42-PROMO (24,000,000 token pool). Activation planned for 2026-06-03 09:00 PT.

Key links: 
- Activation & voucher details: https://app.redwood.ai/console/credits/LL-2026-COHORT42
- Shared plan & upload place: https://drive.google.com/launchlabs/cohort42-plan

Security: Hannah attached the attestation template. To expedite activation we’ve agreed on conditional activation: credits will be applied on June 3 but will be on a 10-day conditional hold until we receive the attestation evidence (SOC2 or completed questionnaire + pen test summary). If security evidence is not provided by June 13, Redwood reserves the right to revoke the voucher.

Action items: 
- Anna / LaunchLabs: upload the filled attestation template and pen test summary by EOD 2026-06-11.
- LaunchLabs: add contact emails for each team in the Drive CSV.
- Redwood (Soojin): finalize voucher entitlements and send a brief usage policy to the cohort.

DocuSign: I’m sending a short acceptance form (DocuSign link) for LaunchLabs to acknowledge the promo terms and the conditional attestation requirement. Please sign to confirm.

If that all looks good I’ll mark this as activated after June 3 and send the voucher code to your onboarding doc.

Thanks everyone — excited to support the cohort.

Priya Natarajan
Head of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com
